desc:
Your name is already written down.
Don't let them read it out loud.

You wake up between life and death, in an old house frozen in time. Something has judged you UNWORTHY.
The only way out is to prove you deserve to live.

DAMNED is in BETA: new content, fixes and updates are coming regularly.

- A new labyrinth every game
- Every creature follows ONE rule. Learn it... or die
- The monsters can HEAR your voice chat. Stay quiet
- Play solo or with friends (up to 7 players)
- Story mode or Rush mode

Will you be judged WORTHY?

Like and Favorite to follow updates.
Join the group for the Supporter lantern and title.
